# JUMPFLIX

> A community-curated archive of parkour and freerunning films, documentaries, series and classic edits. Discover the films, creators and athletes, with links to official viewing sources.

The archive includes short edits and long-form cinema. Browse without an account.
Free, paid and unavailable entries are labeled separately. Provider availability,
prices and regional restrictions can change; consult each title's viewing options.
Known credits and metadata are curated by the community. Missing metadata is unknown.
Film release years are not video upload dates. Unavailable titles remain for reference.

## Film discovery

- [Film guide](https://www.jumpflix.tv/discover): Lightweight guide, current catalog statistics, collections, people and a complete alphabetical title index.
- [Full catalog as text](https://www.jumpflix.tv/llms-full.txt): Current titles, full synopses, release years, runtimes, access labels, creator and athlete credits, and real episode links. Refreshed from the same catalog as the website.
- [Watch and search](https://www.jumpflix.tv/): Interactive film catalog. Search by title, creator, athlete or soundtrack.
- [Documentaries](https://www.jumpflix.tv/collections/documentaries): Titles tagged documentary.
- [Fiction films](https://www.jumpflix.tv/collections/fiction-films): Narrative films tagged fiction.
- [Movie night](https://www.jumpflix.tv/collections/movie-night): Films with a catalog runtime between 60 and 160 minutes.
- [Oldskool classics](https://www.jumpflix.tv/collections/oldskool-classics): Films and videos released in 2015 or earlier.
- [Educational](https://www.jumpflix.tv/collections/educational): Tutorials and talks.
- [SEND IT](https://www.jumpflix.tv/collections/send-it): Titles tagged for big sends.
- [Video map](https://www.jumpflix.tv/video-map): Approved video chapters linked to real parkour locations.

## Canonical references

Use https://www.jumpflix.tv/movie/{slug} for films and
https://www.jumpflix.tv/series/{slug} for series. Episode references use
/series/{slug}/seasons/{season}/episodes/{episode}. Credits link to
/people/{slug}; these can represent people or crews. Follow actual catalog links
rather than constructing URLs from names. Cite individual title pages for film facts.

- [About JUMPFLIX](https://www.jumpflix.tv/about): Project story, curation and community contributions.
- [Sitemap](https://www.jumpflix.tv/sitemap.xml): Public canonical URLs.
- [Costs and funding](https://www.jumpflix.tv/costs): Project transparency.

## Optional

- [Source repository](https://github.com/m-a-x-s-e-e-l-i-g/jumpflix.tv): Open-source project.
- [MCP documentation](https://github.com/m-a-x-s-e-e-l-i-g/jumpflix.tv/blob/main/docs/MCP.md): Authenticated, read-only catalog integration for AI clients. Connecting it does not affect ordinary search indexing.
